create.name: Alison DeNicola
create.bio:
Based in New Preston, Connecticut, Alison DeNicola teaches yoga and meditation, leads retreats and writes. Over some twenty years she has trained in a wide spread of practices, from yoga, guided meditation and yoga nidra to hypnotherapy, shamanic and angelic energy work, chakra study, mudras and feather work, and she folds these into gentle, reflective classes that combine breath, posture, sound and deep rest. She also offers one-to-one energy sessions and coaching for people bringing a creative project to life.

Much of her writing takes the form of illustrated card decks with guidebooks, published by U.S. Games Systems and made with artists such as Sabina Espinet and David Scheirer. Among them are the Enchanted Wheel Oracle, Divine Feather Messenger and two sets on mudras, one for the energy body and one for the five elements. Through Blue Feather Retreats she takes small groups on journeys that mix yoga and meditation with local culture and ceremony, in places such as the Sacred Valley of Peru and Puglia in southern Italy. Closer to home she teaches workshops in the north-eastern United States, including a yoga and tarot weekend at Kripalu with the tarot author Sasha Graham, and she hosts the podcast Beyond the Cards.

books.title: Mudras for Awakening the Energy Body
books.author: Alison DeNicola
books.description: A deck of cards with a guidebook that pairs hand gestures from the yoga tradition with the chakras. Each card shows a mudra, with suggestions for breath, intention and affirmation to use alongside it.

books.title: Mudras for Awakening the Five Elements
books.author: Alison DeNicola
books.description: A companion deck to her first mudra set, this time arranged around earth, water, fire, air and space. Each card offers a hand gesture and a short practice for working with that element.

books.title: Divine Feather Messenger
books.author: Alison DeNicola
books.description: An oracle deck with a guidebook built around the feathers of different birds, painted by David Scheirer. Each card carries a short message for reflection and daily inspiration.

books.title: Nature & Soul Yoga Wisdom
books.author: Alison DeNicola
books.description: A set of cards that links simple yoga poses with images and lessons from the natural world. Each card suggests a posture and a theme to reflect on during practice.

books.title: Auspicious Symbols for Luck and Healing Oracle Deck
books.author: Alison DeNicola
books.description: An oracle deck drawing on good-luck symbols from cultures around the world, illustrated by Sabina Espinet. The guidebook gives the background of each symbol and ways to work with it.

books.title: Enchanted Wheel Oracle
books.author: Alison DeNicola
books.description: A deck of round cards organised around the Celtic Wheel of the Year, with its seasonal festivals and elements. The illustrated guide offers spreads and ways to use the cards for reflection.

books.title: Divine Butterfly Messenger Deck & Book Set
books.author: Alison DeNicola
books.description: A 36-card oracle deck with watercolour butterflies by David Scheirer and an illustrated guidebook. Each card pairs a butterfly with a short message and a quotation.

courses.title: Awaken Your Inner Magic: A Yoga and Tarot Weekend
courses.description: A weekend at Kripalu, led with Sasha Graham, that brings the images of the Rider Waite tarot into yoga, movement, guided visualisation and journaling. Participants explore the major archetypes and suits through the body and practise short readings for themselves and each other.

courses.title: Sacred Andes Wisdom Retreat 2027
courses.description: A week-long group journey to the Sacred Valley of Peru, with a full day at Machu Picchu. The programme includes an Andean despacho offering and a fire ceremony alongside daily practice.

courses.title: Open Your Heart Retreat: Puglia 2027
courses.description: A seven-day stay at a retreat centre near Martina Franca in southern Italy, mixing daily yoga and restorative practice with local food, art and nature. The group visits the old city of Matera, with optional trips to nearby towns.

free_resources.title: Tune Up Your Elemental Energy
free_resources.description: A free downloadable guide, given in exchange for an email address, with short practices for each of the five elements. It moves from grounding with earth through to intuition with space.
